correctness.rationale: The Pitman–Yor EPPF directly factors on a marked r-element block, leaving an independent (α,θ+α) partition of n−r elements. Hence E[M_r K_n]/E[M_r]=1+g_{n−r}(α,θ+α), with the positive exact prefactor C(n,r)(1−α)_{r−1}(θ+α)_{n−r}/(θ+1)_{n−1}. The Chinese-restaurant recurrence for g_j has strictly positive increments and <1 one-step increments, while increasing θ supports the r=1 endpoint by common-uniform coupling. Therefore the covariance sign factor decreases strictly across r, starts positive at r=1, ends negative at r=n for every n≥2, allowing at most one zero. For α>0, gamma-ratio growth g_j∼A_{α,θ}j^α gives the unique macroscopic root ρ=1−(A_{α,θ}/A_{α,θ+α})^(1/α), with A=Γ(θ+1)/(αΓ(θ+α)). For α=0, harmonic increments yield ρ=1−exp(−1/θ). Brownian PD(1/2,0) and PD(1/2,1/2) substitutions give respectively 1−4/π² and 1−π²/16. The θ>−α and θ>0 domains keep all denominators and prefactors valid. Independent exact CRP restricted-growth enumeration verified finite mixed moments for three parameter settings through n=6; the analytic proof establishes all n.
